fixes.title: Checkout total dropped cents due to int() truncation
fixes.bug_description: checkout() returned totals like 19.0 instead of 19.99 because the final amount was passed through int() before being returned, truncating the cents.
fixes.root_cause: The total was cast with int(total) to 'clean up' floating point noise, which silently discarded the fractional part of every price.
fixes.fix: Replaced int(total) with round(total, 2) so the cents are preserved while still removing floating-point noise.
